steps.label: How it works
steps.title: How we work, [from first call to results.]
steps.text: The same four steps for **every service**: websites, automation, video, search, ads and lead lists.

steps.label: Step 1 · Free
steps.title: Free [first look.]
steps.text: Tell us what you want to achieve. If you have a website, we check its speed, how it works on phones and how you show up on Google, and send you a short list of what to fix first.

cards.label: Found on Omek's old site. All fixed.

steps.label: Step 2 · In writing
steps.title: A clear plan [and a fixed price.]
steps.text: We agree what you get, when it is ready and what it costs. You get the price in writing before any work starts.

steps.label: Step 3 · Every week
steps.title: We build [and set it up.]
steps.text: Website, automation, videos or campaigns: you see progress every week in your client portal and approve each stage.

cards.label: From a recent build
cards.note: Omek's main picture on a phone, before and after our rebuild. Google PageSpeed, phone.

steps.label: Step 4 · Every month
steps.title: We keep [it working.]
steps.text: After launch, a monthly plan keeps your videos, search, ads and lead lists working, with a report every month. Cancel with 30 days' notice.
steps.note: Videos, search, ads and lead lists
